entries.91.1: अमितप्रभः of measureless lustre, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, भ्रातृभ्याम् to his two brothers, एतत् this, आख्याय having related, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, पुनः एव once again, धर्मयुक्तम् charged with dharma, इदम् this, वचः word, आह spoke
entries.91.2: वसिष्ठम् Vasishtha, वामदेवं च and Vamadeva, जाबालिम् Jabali, अथ then, कश्यपम् Kashyapa, अश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान् foremost in the horse-sacrifice, सर्वप्रवरान् most excellent of all, द्विजांश्च and the twice-born
entries.91.3: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, एतान् these, सर्वान् all, समानीय having assembled, मन्त्रयित्वा च and having taken counsel, लक्षणसम्पन्नम् endowed with the marks, हयम् the horse, समाधिना with due ceremony, विमोक्ष्यामि I shall set free
entries.91.4: राघवेण by Raghava, उक्तम् spoken, तत् that, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, त्वरितविक्रमः swift in action, सर्वान् all, द्विजान् the twice-born, समाहूय having summoned, राघवम् to Raghava, दर्शयामास presented them
entries.91.5: ते they, देवसङ्काशम् godlike, कृतपादाभिवन्दनम् who had saluted their feet, सुदुराधर्षम् most unassailable, राघवम् Raghava, दृष्ट्वा having seen, आशीर्भिः with benedictions, समपूजयन् honoured
entries.91.6: महायशाः of great renown, सः that, राघवः Raghava, तदा then, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, भूत्वा having become, द्विजसत्तमान् to the best of the twice-born, अश्वमेधस्य of the horse-sacrifice, अभिप्रायम् हि his intent indeed, आचचक्षे declared
entries.91.7: ते तु and they, सर्वे all, द्विजाः the twice-born, रामस्य of Rama, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, वृषध्वजम् him whose banner bears the bull, नमस्कृत्वा having saluted, अश्वमेधम् the horse-sacrifice, सर्वशः in every way, पूजयन्ति स्म extolled
entries.91.8: सः he, तेषाम् their, द्विजमुख्यानाम् of the foremost of the twice-born, अश्वमेधाश्रितम् touching the horse-sacrifice, अद्भुतदर्शनम् wondrous to behold, वाक्यम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, तदा then, भृशम् greatly, प्रीतः pleased, अभवत् became
entries.91.9: रामः Rama, तेषाम् their, तत् that, कर्म undertaking, विज्ञाय having learnt, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said, महात्मने to the great-souled, सुग्रीवाय Sugriva, द्रुतम् swiftly, दूतान् messengers, प्रेषयस्व send
entries.91.10: यथा so that, महद्भिः mighty, बहुभिः many, वनौकसाम् of the forest-dwellers, हरिभिः सार्धम् along with the monkeys, आगच्छ come, ते to you, भद्रम् good fortune, महोत्सवम् the great festival, अनुभोक्तुम् हि to share in indeed
entries.91.11: अतुलविक्रमः of unmatched valour, बिभीषणश्च and Vibhishana, कामगैः going where they will, बहुभिः many, रक्षोभिः by rakshasas, वृतः attended, महायज्ञम् the great sacrifice, अश्वमेधम् the horse-sacrifice, आयातु let him come to
entries.91.12: महाभागाः the greatly blessed, ये राजानः what kings, मे my, प्रियचिकीर्षवः wish to do what pleases, सानुगाः with their followers, क्षिप्रम् swiftly, अनुत्तमम् the most excellent, यज्ञम् sacrifice, द्रष्टुम् to behold, आयान्तु let them come
entries.91.13: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, देशान्तरगताः gone to other lands, धर्मसमाहिताः established in dharma, ये च and whatever, द्विजाः twice-born there are, तान् them, सर्वान् all, अश्वमेधाय for the horse-sacrifice, आमन्त्रयस्व invite
entries.91.14: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, तपोधनाः rich in austerity, ऋषयश्च and the sages, आहूयन्ताम् let them be summoned, देशान्तरगताः gone to other lands, सर्वे all, सदाराश्च with their wives, द्विजातयः the twice-born, तथैव likewise, तालावचराः the musicians, तथैव and likewise, नटनर्तकाः players and dancers
entries.91.15: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, गोमत्या by the Gomati, नैमिशे in Naimisha, वने wood, सुमहान् a very great, यज्ञवाटश्च sacrificial enclosure, आज्ञाप्यताम् let it be ordered, तत् हि that indeed, अनुत्तमम् is the most excellent, पुण्यम् holy ground
entries.91.16: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, शान्तयश्च and the rites of appeasement, समन्ततः on every side, प्रवर्त्यन्ताम् let them be set going
entries.91.17: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, धर्मज्ञाः the knowers of dharma, शतशः चापि and by the hundred, नैमिशे at Naimisha, अनुत्तमम् the most excellent, क्रतुमुख्यम् foremost of rites, महायज्ञम् the great sacrifice, अनुभूय having partaken of
entries.91.18: धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, असौ that, सर्वः entire, तुष्टः pleased, पुष्टश्च and well nourished, यथाविधि according to rule, मानितश्च and honoured, प्रीतिम् delight, यास्यति shall attain, जनः the people, शीघ्रम् swiftly, आमन्त्र्यताम् let them be invited
entries.91.19: महाबल O you of great strength, वपुष्मताम् of goodly grain, तण्डुलानाम् of rice, शतम् a hundred, वाहसहस्राणाम् thousands of cartloads, तिलमुद्गानाम् of sesame and mung, अयुतम् a myriad, अग्रे ahead, प्रयातु let it go
entries.91.20: चणकानाम् of chickpeas, कुलित्थानाम् of horse-gram, माषाणाम् of black gram, लवणस्य च and of salt, अतः accordingly, अनुरूपम् in fitting measure, स्नेहं च and oils, सङ्क्षिप्तम् एव च and in concentrate, गन्धम् fragrances
entries.91.21: बहुलाः abundant, सुवर्णकोट्यः crores of gold, शतोत्तराः more than a hundredfold, हिरण्यस्य of silver, भरतः Bharata, अग्रतः to the front, कृत्वा having sent, समाधिना with due order, अग्रे ahead, गच्छतु let him go
entries.91.22: अन्तरा among them, पण्यवीथ्यश्च rows of market stalls, सर्वे all, नटनर्तकाः च and players and dancers, सूदाः cooks, बहवः many, नार्यश्च and women, नित्यम् ever, यौवनशालिनः in the bloom of youth
entries.91.23: ते those, सैन्यानि armies, भरतेन तु सार्धम् together with Bharata, अग्रतः ahead, यान्तु let them go, नैगमाः the townsmen, बलवृद्धाश्च and elders of the army, सुसमाहिताः well composed, द्विजाश्च and the twice-born
entries.91.24: कर्मान्तिकान् the overseers of works, वर्धकिनः the carpenters, कोशाध्यक्षान् the treasurers, नैगमांश्च and the townsmen, मम my, मातॄः mothers, तथा likewise, सर्वाः all, कुमारान्तःपुराणि च and the inner apartments of the princes
entries.91.25: महायशाः of great renown, काञ्चनीम् the golden image, मम my, पत्नीं च of my wife, दीक्षायाम् in the consecration, कर्मणि in the rite, ज्ञान् च and those who know it, अग्रतः to the front, भरतः Bharata, कृत्वा having placed, अग्रे ahead, गच्छतु let him go
entries.91.26: महाबलः the mighty, नरश्रेष्ठः best of men, महौजसाम् of great might, सानुगानाम् with their followers, पार्थिवानाम् for the kings, महार्हाः of great worth, उपकार्याश्च and pavilions, व्यादिदेश ordered
entries.92.1: भरताग्रजः the elder brother of Bharata, तत् that, सर्वम् all, अखिलेन entirely, आशु swiftly, प्रस्थाप्य having sent forward, लक्षणसम्पन्नम् endowed with the marks, कृष्णसारम् dark-spotted, हयम् the horse, मुमोच ह did indeed set free
entries.92.2: ऋत्विग्भिः सार्धम् together with the officiating priests, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अश्वतन्त्रे in charge of the horse, नियोज्य च and having appointed, ततः then, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, सैन्येन सह along with the army, नैमिशम् to Naimisha, अभ्यगच्छत् went
entries.92.3: श्रीमान् the illustrious, महाबाहुः mighty-armed, परमम् most, अद्भुतम् wondrous, यज्ञवाटम् sacrificial enclosure, दृष्ट्वा having seen, अतुलम् unmatched, प्रबर्षम् delight, लेभे obtained, इति thus, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.92.4: नैमिषे at Naimisha, वसतः as he dwelt, तस्य to him, सर्वे एव all, नराधिपाः the rulers of men, उपहारांश्च gifts, आनिन्युः brought, रामः Rama, तान् them, प्रत्यपूजयत् honoured in return
entries.92.5: महामतिः of great mind, नरश्रेष्ठः best of men, महात्मनाम् great-souled, सानुगानाम् with their followers, पार्थिवानाम् for the kings, महार्हाः of great worth, उपकार्याश्च and pavilions, व्यादिदेश ordered
entries.92.6: तदा then, भरतः Bharata, शत्रुघ्नसहितः together with Shatrughna, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, सानुगानाम् with their followers, अन्नपानानि food and drink, वस्त्राणि garments, आशु swiftly, सन्ददौ bestowed
entries.92.7: तदा then, महात्मानः great-souled, वानराश्च and the vanaras, सुग्रीवसहिताः together with Sugriva, सर्वे all, प्रणताः bowing, विप्राणाम् for the brahmins, परिवेषणम् the serving of food, चक्रिरे performed
entries.92.8: बिभीषणश्च and Vibhishana, स्रग्विभिः wearing garlands, बहुभिः by many, रक्षोभिः by rakshasas, वृतः attended, उग्रतपसाम् of fierce austerity, महात्मनाम् great-souled, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, पूजाम् the honouring, चक्रे performed
entries.92.9: एवम् thus, सुविहितः well ordered, हयमेधः the horse-sacrifice, यज्ञः rite, अभ्यवर्तत went forward, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, अगुप्ता guarded, हयचर्या च and the ranging of the horse, प्रवर्तत proceeded, राजसिंहस्य of the lion among kings, ईदृशम् such, उत्तमम् most excellent, यज्ञप्रवरम् foremost of sacrifices
entries.92.10: महात्मनः of the great-souled one, तत्र there, हयमेधे at the horse-sacrifice, अन्यः another, शब्दः sound, न अभवत् arose not, विस्रब्धः without misgiving, छन्दतः at will, देहि give, यावत् until, याचकाः the suppliants, तुष्यन्ति are satisfied
entries.92.11: महात्मनः of the great-souled one, क्रतुमध्ये in the midst of the rite, तावत् so much, सर्वाणि all things, दत्तानि were given, विविधानि various, गौडानि sweets of molasses, तथैव च and likewise, खाण्डवानि confections of sugar
entries.92.12: यावत् so long as, अर्थिनाम् of the suppliants, ओष्ठात् from the lip, वचनम् a word, न निस्सृतम् had not issued, तावत् by then, वानररक्षोभिः by the vanaras and rakshasas, दत्तम् एव the gift already made, अभ्यदृश्यत was seen
entries.92.13: हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते thronged with glad and thriving folk, राज्ञः of the king, तस्मिन् in that, यज्ञवरे best of sacrifices, तत्र there, न कश्चित् no one, मलिनः was soiled, दीनः वा or wretched, अथ or, कृशतः lean
entries.92.14: ये च and those who, तत्र there, महात्मानः great-souled, चिरजीविनः long-lived, मुनयः sages, तादृशम् such, यज्ञम् a sacrifice, न अस्मरन् did not recall, कदाचन ever, सः such a one, न अपि आसीत् nor had there been
entries.92.15: यः who, सुवर्णेन with gold, कृत्यवान् had business, सः he, सुवर्णम् gold, लभते स्म obtained, वित्तार्थी one seeking wealth, वित्तम् wealth, लभते obtains, रत्नार्थी one seeking jewels, रत्नम् एव च and jewels
entries.92.16: अनिशम् unceasingly, दीयमानानाम् being given away, रजतानाम् of silver, सुवर्णानाम् of gold, अश्मनाम् of gems, अथ and, वाससाम् of garments, राशिः a heap, समुपदृश्यते was seen
entries.92.17: शक्रस्य of Shakra, धनेशस्य of the lord of wealth, यमस्य of Yama, वरुणस्य वा or of Varuna, ईदृशः such, नः by us, दृष्टपूर्वः न was never seen before, एवम् thus, तपोधनाः those rich in austerity, ऊचुः said
entries.92.18: सर्वत्र everywhere, वानराः the vanaras, तस्थुः stood, सर्वत्र एव च and everywhere too, राक्षसाः the rakshasas, पूर्णहस्ताः with full hands, अर्थिभ्यः to the suppliants, वासोधनान्नम् raiment and wealth and food, भृशम् abundantly, ददुः gave
entries.92.19: राजसिंहस्य of the lion among kings, ईदृशः such, सर्वगुणान्वितः endowed with every excellence, यज्ञः the sacrifice, अथो and so, साग्रम् and more, संवत्सरम् for a year, वर्तते goes on, न च हीयते and does not fail
entries.93.1: तथाभूते of such a kind, परमाद्भुते most wondrous, यज्ञे when the sacrifice, वर्तमाने च was in progress, मुनिपुङ्गवः the bull among sages, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, सशिष्यः with his disciples, आशु swiftly, आजगाम came
entries.93.2: सः he, दिव्यसङ्काशम् of heavenly aspect, अद्भुतदर्शनम् wondrous to behold, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, दृष्ट्वा having seen, ऋषिवाटानाम् of the sages' enclosures, एकान्ते in a quiet corner, शुभान् fair, उटजान् leaf-huts, चकार made
entries.93.3: फलमूलैः with fruits and roots, पूर्णान् filled, शोभनान् goodly, बहून् many, शकटांश्च and carts, अविदूरतः not far off, रुचिरे in the lovely, वाल्मीकिवाटे enclosure of Valmiki, स्थापयन् setting
entries.93.4: सुमहातेजाः of exceedingly great splendour, परमात्मवान् wholly self-possessed, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, राज्ञा by the king, महात्मभिः by the great-souled, मुनिभिश्च and by the sages, सुपूजितः well honoured, आसीत् was, न्यवसत् dwelt there
entries.93.5: सः he, हृष्टौ delighted, शिष्यौ to his two disciples, अब्रवीत् said, युवाम् you two, समाहितौ intent, गत्वा having gone, कृत्स्नम् the entire, रामायणम् Ramayana, काव्यम् poem, परया with the utmost, मुदा joy, गायेथाम् sing
entries.93.6: पुण्येषु in the holy, ऋषिवाटेषु enclosures of the sages, ब्राह्मणावसथेषु च and in the dwellings of brahmins, रथ्यासु in the streets, राजमार्गेषु on the royal roads, पार्थिवानाम् of kings, गृहेषु च and in the houses
entries.93.7: रामस्य of Rama, भवनद्वारि at the gate of the palace, यत्र where, कर्म the rite, कुर्वते च and they perform, ऋत्विजाम् of the officiating priests, अग्रतश्चैव and before them, तत्र there, विशेषतः above all, गेयम् it is to be sung
entries.93.8: अत्र here, इमानि these, स्वादूनि savoury, विविधानि च and various, फलानि fruits, पर्वताग्रेषु on the mountain heights, जातानि grown, आस्वाद्य आस्वाद्य tasting again and again, गायताम् sing on
entries.93.9: वत्सौ O my two children, फलानि वै the fruits indeed, सुमृष्टानि well cleaned, मूलानि च and roots, भक्षयित्वा having eaten, श्रमम् weariness, न यास्यथः you shall not come to, नगरात् बहिः outside the city, आस्यथः you shall stay
entries.93.10: महीपतिः the lord of the earth, रामः Rama, श्रवणाय for the hearing, यदि if, शब्दापयेत् should summon you, उपविष्टानाम् seated, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, ततः then, गेयम् the singing, प्रवर्तताम् let it proceed
entries.93.11: दिवसे in a day, विंशतिः twenty, सर्गाः cantos, मधुरया in a sweet, गिरा voice, गेयाः are to be sung, तत्र therein, बहुभिः with many, प्रमाणैः measures, पुरा formerly, मया by me, यथोद्दिष्टा as were appointed
entries.93.12: धनकाङ्क्षया out of longing for wealth, स्वल्पः अपि even the least, लोभश्चापि greed too, न कर्तव्यः is not to be entertained, आश्रमस्थानाम् for those dwelling in a hermitage, फलमूलोपजीविना living on fruit and root, धनेन with wealth, किम् what use
entries.93.13: दारकौ O children, सः that, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, युवाम् you two, कस्य whose are you, इति thus, यदि if, पृच्छेत् should ask, आवाम् we two, वाल्मीकिशिष्यौ the disciples of Valmiki, स्वः are, नराधिपम् to the ruler of men, एवम् thus, ब्रूतम् say
entries.93.14: विगतज्वरौ free of anxiety, सुमधुराः most sweet, इमाः these, तन्त्रीः lute-strings, अपूर्वदर्शनम् never seen before, स्थानं वा and the modes, मूर्च्छयित्वा having tuned, सुमधुरम् most sweetly, गायताम् sing
entries.93.15: आदिप्रभृति from the very beginning, गेयम् the singing, स्यात् should be, पार्थिवम् the king, न च अवज्ञाय and not slighting him, राजा the king, धर्मतः by dharma, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, पिता हि is indeed the father, भवति is
entries.93.16: तत् therefore, युवाम् you two, हृष्टमनसौ glad at heart, श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते at dawn, समास्थितौ standing ready, तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् joined with lute and measure, मधुरम् sweet, गेयम् the song, गायेथाम् sing
entries.93.17: तदा then, महायशाः of great renown, परमोदारः most noble, प्राचेतसः son of Prachetas, मुनिः the sage, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, इति thus, बहुशः many times, सन्दिश्य having instructed them, तूष्णीम् silent, आसीत् remained
entries.93.18: तेन by that, मुनिना sage, सन्दिष्टौ instructed, अरिन्दमौ tamers of foes, तौ those two, उभौ both, मैथिलीसुतौ sons of Maithili, तथा एव even so, करवाव let us do, इति thus, निर्जग्मतुः went forth
entries.93.19: तौ those two, कुमारौ princes, ऋषिभाषिताम् spoken by the sage, ताम् that, अद्भुताम् wondrous, वाणीम् utterance, तदा then, हृदये in their hearts, निवेश्य having laid up, समुत्सुकौ full of eagerness, तौ those two, अश्विनौ यथा as the Ashvins did, भार्गवनीतिसंहिताम् the collected polity of Bhargava, समम् together, निशाम् the night, ऊषतुः passed
entries.94.1: तौ those two, रजन्याम् when the night, प्रभातायाम् had brightened into dawn, स्नातौ having bathed, हुतहुताशनौ having offered into the fire, पूर्वम् beforehand, ऋषिणा by the sage, यथोक्तम् as had been said, सर्वम् all, तत्र there, उपगायताम् sang
entries.94.2: काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, पूर्वाचार्यविजिर्मिताम् fashioned by the first of teachers, अपूर्वाम् unlike any before, गेयेन with song, समलङ्कृताम् adorned, पाठ्यजातिं च and that manner of recitation, ताम् that, शुश्राव heard
entries.94.3: राघवः Raghava, बहुभिः with many, प्रमाणैः measures, बद्धाम् bound, तन्त्रीलयसमन्विताम् joined with lute and measure, बालाभ्याम् from the two boys, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौतूहलपरः filled with curiosity, अभवत् became
entries.94.4: अथ then, कर्मान्तरे in an interval of the rite, नरव्याघ्रः the tiger among men, राजा king, महामुनीन् the great sages, पार्थिवांश्च and the kings, पण्डितान् the learned, नैगमान् तथा and likewise the townsmen, समाहूय summoned
entries.94.5: पौराणिकान् those versed in ancient lore, शब्दविदः knowers of words, ये च and those, वृद्धाः elders, द्विजातयः twice-born, स्वराणाम् of tones, लक्षणज्ञांश्च and knowers of the marks, उत्सुकान् eager, द्विजसत्तमान् best of the twice-born
entries.94.6: लक्षणज्ञान् knowers of the marks, गान्धर्वान् masters of music, विशेषतः above all, नैगमांश्च and the townsmen, पादाक्षरसमासज्ञान् knowing feet and syllables and compounds, छन्दःसु in prosody, परिनिष्ठितान् fully accomplished
entries.94.7: कलामात्राविशेषज्ञान् knowing the distinctions of beat and measure, ज्योतिषे in astronomy, परम् the highest, गतान् च and who had reached, क्रियाकल्पविदः चैव and knowers of ritual procedure, तथा likewise, कार्यविदः knowers of practical affairs, जनान् men
entries.94.8: भाषाज्ञान् knowers of languages, इङ्गितज्ञांश्च and readers of gesture, नैगमांश्च and the townsmen, अशेषतः चापि and without exception, हेतूपचारकुशलान् skilled in the handling of arguments, वचने in speech, हैतुकान् चापि and reasoners
entries.94.9: छन्दोविदः knowers of metre, पुराणज्ञान् knowers of the Puranas, वैदिकान् versed in the Veda, द्विजसत्तमान् best of the twice-born, चित्रज्ञान् knowers of painting, वृत्तसूत्रज्ञान् knowers of metrical rules, गीतनृत्यविशारदान् skilled in song and dance
entries.94.10: शास्त्रज्ञान् knowers of the sciences, नीतिनिपुणान् adept in policy, वेदान्तार्थप्रबोधकान् expounders of the sense of Vedanta, एतान् these, सर्वान् all, समानीय having assembled, गातारौ the two singers, समवेशयत् seated
entries.94.11: सर्वे all, मुनिगणाः the companies of sages, महौजसः of great might, पार्थिवाश्च and the kings, राजानम् the king, तौ those two, गायकौ च and the singers, दृष्ट्वा having seen, चक्षुर्भ्याम् with their eyes, पिबन्तः इव as though drinking them in
entries.94.12: सर्वे एव all of them, समन्ततः on every side, परस्परम् to one another, इदम् this, ऊचुः च and said, उभौ both, रामस्य of Rama, सदृशौ are the likeness, बिम्बात् from a reflected image, बिम्बम् इव as an image, उत्थितौ risen
entries.94.13: यदि if, जटिलौ with matted hair, न स्याताम् they were not, यदि if, न वल्कलधरौ were not clad in bark, गायतोः of the two who sing, राघवस्य च and of Raghava, विशेषम् a difference, न अधिगच्छामः we perceive not
entries.94.14: तेषाम् as they, एवम् thus, संवदताम् conversed, तौ those two, उभौ both, मुनिदारकौ children of the hermitage, तत्र there, श्रोतॄणाम् of the hearers, हर्षवर्धनम् increasing the joy, गेयम् the song, प्रचक्रतुः began
entries.94.15: ततः then, मधुरम् sweet, अतिमानुषम् more than human, गान्धर्वम् music, प्रवृत्तम् began, सर्वे all, श्रोतारः the hearers, गानसम्पदा with the wealth of song, तृप्तिम् satiety, न च ययुः came not to
entries.94.16: आदितः from the beginning, नारददर्शितम् shown by Narada, पूर्वसर्गम् the first canto, प्रवृत्तम् was begun, ततः प्रभृति from that point onward, सर्गांश्च the cantos, यावत् until, विंशति twenty, अगायताम् they sang
entries.94.17: ततः then, अपराह्णसमये in the hour of the afternoon, भ्रातृवत्सलः fond of his brother, राघवः Raghava, तान् those, विंशतिसर्गान् twenty cantos, श्रुत्वा having heard, भ्रातरम् to his brother, समभाषत spoke
entries.94.18: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, महात्मनोः to the two great-souled ones, सुवर्णस्य of gold, अष्टादशसहस्राणि eighteen thousand, यत् whatever, अन्यत् else, अभिकाङ्क्षितम् is desired, शीघ्रम् swiftly, प्रयच्छ give, सः that, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, बालयोः to the two boys, पृथक्पृथक् to each separately, शीघ्रम् swiftly, ददौ gave
entries.94.19: कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, दीयमानम् तु though it was offered, सुवर्णम् the gold, न अगृह्णीताम् took not, विस्मितौ amazed, महात्मानौ great-souled, अनेन with this, किम् what use, इति thus, ऊचतुः च and said
entries.94.20: वन्येन with what the wood yields, फलमूलेन with fruit and root, निरतौ content, वनवासिनौ dwellers in the forest, वने in the wood, सुवर्णेन with gold, हिरण्येन with silver, किम् what, करिष्यावहे shall we two do
entries.94.21: तयोः as those two, तथा thus, प्रब्रुवतोः spoke, श्रोतारश्चैव the hearers, रामश्च and Rama, सर्वे एव all of them, कौतूहलसमन्विताः filled with curiosity, सुविस्मिताः greatly amazed
entries.94.22: महातेजाः of great splendour, रामः Rama, तस्य its, काव्यस्य of the poem, आगमं चैव and the origin, श्रोतुम् to hear, उत्सुकः eager, तौ those, उभौ both, मुनिदारकौ children of the hermitage, पप्रच्छ asked
entries.94.23: इदम् this, काव्यम् poem, किम्प्रमाणम् of what compass, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, का प्रतिष्ठा what is its standing, महतः of the great, काव्यस्य poem, कर्ता the author, असौ that, मुनिपुङ्गवः bull among sages, क्व च and where is he
entries.94.24: पृच्छन्तम् as he asked, राघवम् to Raghava, मुनिदारकौ the two children of the hermitage, वाक्यम् these words, ऊचतुः said
entries.94.25: भगवान् the venerable, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, कर्ता is the author, यज्ञसंविधम् to the sacrificial ground, सम्प्राप्तः has come, येन by whom, इदम् this, चरितम् history, तुभ्यम् to you, अशेषम् entire, सम्प्रदर्शितम् has been set forth
entries.94.26: तपस्विना by the ascetic, भार्गवेण of the line of Bhrigu, श्लोकानाम् of verses, चतुर्विशत्सहस्रकम् four and twenty thousand, उपाख्यानशतं चैव and a hundred episodes, सन्निबद्धम् हि have indeed been composed
entries.94.27: राजन् O king, महात्मना by the great-souled one, आदिप्रभृति from the beginning onward, पञ्चसर्गशतानि च and five hundred cantos, षट् six, काण्डानि books, सोत्तराणि together with the Uttara, इह here, कृतानि have been made, अस्माकम् our, गुरुणा by the teacher, ऋषिणा by the sage, तव your, चरितम् history, कृतानि has been composed
entries.94.28: प्रतिष्ठा the standing of it, आजीवितम् as long as life, यावत् so long, तावत् so long, सर्वस्य for all, वर्तते endures
entries.94.29: महात्मना by the great-souled one, सोत्तराणि together with the Uttara, महारथ O great chariot-warrior, राजन् O king, यदि if, श्रवणाय for the hearing, बुद्धिः a mind, कृता is made, कर्मान्तरे in an interval of the rite, क्षणीभूतः having leisure, सहानुजः along with your brothers, तत् that, शृणुष्व hear
entries.94.30: रामः Rama, बाढम् इति so be it, अब्रवीत् said, तौ च and those two, राघवम् Raghava, अनुज्ञाप्य having taken leave of, प्रहृष्टौ delighted, यत्र where, मुनिपुङ्गवः the bull among sages, आस्ते abode, स्थानम् the place, जग्मतुः went to
entries.94.31: रामः अपि Rama too, मुनिभिः सार्धम् together with the sages, महात्मभिः great-souled, पार्थिवैश्च and with the kings, तत् that, गीतिमाधुर्यम् sweetness of song, श्रुत्वा having heard, कर्मशालाम् the hall of the rite, उपागमत् went to
entries.94.32: सः he, ताललयोपपन्नम् furnished with beat and measure, सर्गान्वितम् set out in cantos, स्वरशब्दयुक्तम् joined with tone and word, तन्त्रीलयव्यञ्जनयोगयुक्तम् knit with lute and measure and articulation, कुशीलवाभ्याम् by Kusha and Lava, परिगीयमानम् being sung, तत् that, शुश्राव heard
entries.95.1: रामः Rama, एवम् thus, बहूनि many, अहानि days, मुनिभिः सार्धम् together with the sages, पार्थिवैः with the kings, वानरैः सह and with the vanaras, परमम् most, शुभम् auspicious, तत् that, गीतम् song, शुश्राव heard
entries.95.2: तस्मिन् in that, गीते song, सीतापुत्रौ the sons of Sita, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, विज्ञाय तु having recognised, तस्याः that, परिषदः assembly's, मध्ये in the midst, रामः Rama, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, आत्ममनीषया by his own judgement, शुद्धसमाचारान् of pure conduct, दूतान् messengers, आहूय having summoned
entries.95.3: इतः from here, भगवतः of the venerable one, अन्तिकम् to the presence, गच्छध्वम् go, मद्वचः my word, ब्रूत speak
entries.95.4: यदि if, शुद्धसमाचारा she is of pure conduct, यदि वा or if, वीतकल्मषा her stain is gone, महामुनिम् the great sage, अनुमान्य having gained his consent, इह here, आत्मनः of herself, शुद्धिम् the proof of purity, करोतु let her make
entries.95.5: मुनेः of the sage, छन्दं च and the wish, प्रत्ययम् the proof, दातुकामायाः of her who wishes to give, सीतायाश्च and of Sita, मनोगतम् what is in the heart, विज्ञाय having learnt, ततः then, लघु quickly, मे to me, शंसत report
entries.95.6: श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते तु and at dawn, जनकात्मजा the daughter of Janaka, मैथिली Maithili, ममैव च and my own, शोधनार्थम् for the sake of clearing, परिषन्मध्ये in the midst of the assembly, शपथम् the oath, करोतु let her make
entries.95.7: राघवस्य of Raghava, एतत् this, परमम् most, अद्भुतम् wondrous, वचः word, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, दूताः the messengers, यत्र where, मुनिपुङ्गवः the bull among sages, आस्ते abode, बाढम् without delay, सम्प्रययुः set forth
entries.95.8: ते they, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, अमितप्रभम् of measureless lustre, महात्मानम् the great-souled one, प्रणम्य having saluted, ते they, मृदूनि gentle, मधुराणि च and sweet, रामवाक्यानि the words of Rama, ऊचुः spoke
entries.95.9: सुमहातेजाः of exceedingly great splendour, मुनिः the sage, तेषाम् their, तत् that, व्याहृतम् utterance, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्य of Rama, मनोगतं च and what was in his heart, विज्ञाय having perceived, अथ then, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.95.10: एवम् thus, भवतु let it be, वः to you, भद्रम् good fortune, यथा as, राघवः Raghava, वदति says, तथा so, सीता Sita, करिष्यते shall do, स्त्रियाः for a woman, पतिः the husband, दैवतम् हि is indeed her deity
entries.95.11: मुनिना by the sage, तथा so, उक्ताः addressed, सर्वे all, राजदूताः the king's messengers, महौजसम् of great might, राघवम् Raghava, क्षिप्रम् swiftly, प्रत्येत्य having returned to, मुनिवाक्यम् the sage's word, बभाषिरे reported
entries.95.12: ततः then, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, वाक्यम् the word, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रहृष्टः delighted, तत्र there, समेतान् assembled, ऋषींश्च the sages, राज्ञश्चैव and the kings, अभ्यभाषत addressed
entries.95.13: भगवन्तः O venerable ones, सशिष्याः वै with your disciples indeed, सानुगाः with their followers, नराधिपाश्च and the rulers of men, यश्च अन्यः अपि and whoever else, काङ्क्षते desires it, सीताशपथम् the oath of Sita, पश्यन्तु let them behold
entries.95.14: महात्मनः of the great-souled, राघवस्य Raghava, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, सर्वेषाम् of all, ऋषिमुख्यानाम् the foremost of sages, महान् a great, साधुवादः cry of approval, अभूत् arose
entries.95.15: महात्मानः great-souled, राजानश्च and the kings, राघवम् Raghava, प्रशंसन्ति स्म praised, नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, भुवि on earth, त्वयि एव in you alone, उपपन्नम् is it fitting, न अन्यतः and in no other
entries.95.16: शत्रुसूदनः the slayer of foes, राघवः Raghava, एवम् thus, श्वोभूतः on the morrow, इति thus, विनिश्चयम् his resolve, कृत्वा having made, तदा then, तान् those, सर्वान् all, विसर्जयामास dismissed
entries.95.17: महानुभावः of great dignity, सः that, महात्मा great-souled, राजसिंहः lion among kings, इति thus, सम्प्रविचार्य having deliberated, श्वोभूते on the morrow, शपथस्य of the oath, निश्चयम् वै the resolve indeed, महतः the great, मुनीन् sages, नृपांश्च and the kings, सर्वान् all, विससर्ज dismissed
entries.96.1: तस्याम् when that, रजन्याम् night, व्युष्टायाम् had brightened into dawn, महातेजाः of great splendour, यज्ञवाटगतः gone to the sacrificial enclosure, नृपः the king, राघवः Raghava, सर्वान् all, ऋषीन् the sages, शब्दापयति summons
entries.96.2: वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, वामदेवश्च and Vamadeva, जाबालिः Jabali, अथ then, काश्यपः Kashyapa, विश्वामित्रः Vishvamitra, दीर्घतपाः Dirghatapas, महातपाः of great austerity, दुर्वासाश्च and Durvasas
entries.96.3: पुलस्त्यः अपि Pulastya too, तथा likewise, शक्तिः Shakti, भार्गवश्चैव and of Bhrigu's line, वामनः Vamana, दीर्घायुः long-lived, मार्कण्डेयश्च and Markandeya, महायशाः of great renown, मौद्गल्यश्च and Maudgalya
entries.96.4: गर्गश्च and Garga, च्यवनश्चैव and Chyavana, धर्मवित् knower of dharma, शतानन्दश्च and Shatananda, तेजस्वी splendid, भरद्वाजश्च and Bharadvaja, सुप्रभः of fair lustre, अग्निपुत्रश्च हि and the son of Agni indeed
entries.96.5: नारदः Narada, पर्वतश्चैव and Parvata, महायशाः of great renown, गौतमश्च and Gautama, कात्यायनः Katyayana, सुयज्ञश्च and Suyajna, तपसाम् of austerities, निधिः the treasury, अगस्त्यः हि Agastya indeed
entries.96.6: एते these, चान्ये and others, बहवः many, संशितव्रताः of strict vows, मुनयः sages, कौतूहलसमाविष्टाः filled with curiosity, सर्वे एव all of them, समागताः came together
entries.96.7: महावीर्याः of great might, राक्षसाश्च and the rakshasas, महाबलाः mighty, वानराश्च and the vanaras, महात्मानः great-souled, सर्वे एव all of them, कुतूहलात् out of curiosity, समाजग्मुः assembled
entries.96.8: ये क्षत्रियाः what kshatriyas, शूद्राश्च and shudras, वैश्याश्चैव and vaishyas, सहस्रशः by the thousand, नानादेशगताः चैव and come from many lands, संशितव्रताः of strict vows, ब्राह्मणाः brahmins
entries.96.9: ज्ञाननिष्ठाः grounded in knowledge, कर्मनिष्ठाः grounded in works, तथा likewise, अपरे others, योगनिष्ठाः grounded in yoga, सीताशपथवीक्षार्थम् to behold the oath of Sita, सर्वे एव all of them, समागताः came together
entries.96.10: तदा then, समागतम् assembled, अश्मभूतम् turned to stone, अचलम् इव like a mountain, सर्वम् all, श्रुत्वा having heard, मुनिवरः the best of sages, तूर्णम् swiftly, ससीतः along with Sita, समुपागमत् came
entries.96.11: सीता Sita, अवाङ्मुखी her face bent down, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, बाष्पगला her voice choked with tears, रामम् Rama, मनोगतम् in her heart, कृत्वा having kept, तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, पृष्ठतः तु and behind, अन्वगच्छत् followed
entries.96.12: ब्रह्माणम् Brahma, अनुगामिनीम् following after, श्रुतिम् इव like sacred revelation itself, आयान्तीम् approaching, वाल्मीकेः of Valmiki, पृष्ठतः behind, सीताम् Sita, दृष्ट्वा having seen, महान् a great, साधुवादः cry of approval, अभूत् arose
entries.96.13: ततः then, दुःखजन्मविशालेन vast with the sorrow it gave birth to, शोकेन with grief, आकुलितात्मनाम् their hearts confounded, सर्वेषाम् of all, हलहलाशब्दः a tumultuous murmur, एवम् thus, आबभौ arose
entries.96.14: केचित् तु some, साधु राम इति well done Rama, अपरे others, साधु सीता इति well done Sita, तत्र there, अन्ये others, प्रेक्षकाः the onlookers, उभौ एव च both alike, सम्प्रचुक्रुशुः cried aloud
entries.96.15: ततः then, मुनिपुङ्गवः the bull among sages, सीतासहायः with Sita at his side, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, जनौघस्य of the throng of people, मध्ये into the midst, प्रविश्य having entered, राघवम् to Raghava, इति thus, होवाच declared
entries.96.16: दाशरथे O son of Dasharatha, इयम् this, सीता Sita, सुव्रता of good vows, धर्मचारिणी walking in dharma, अपवादैः by slanders, परित्यक्ता was cast off, मम my, आश्रमसमीपतः near the hermitage
entries.96.17: महाव्रत O you of great vows, राम O Rama, लोकापवादभीतस्य of you who feared the slander of the world, तव to you, प्रत्ययम् the proof, सीता Sita, दास्यते shall give, तत् therefore, अनुज्ञातुम् to give leave, अर्हसि you ought
entries.96.18: इमौ तु and these two, जानकीपुत्रौ sons of Janaki, उभौ both, यमजातकौ च and twin-born, दुर्धर्षौ unassailable, तव एव yours alone, सुतौ are the sons, ते to you, एतत् this, सत्यम् is the truth, ब्रवीमि I declare
entries.96.19: राघवनन्दन O delight of the Raghavas, अहम् I, प्रचेतसः of Prachetas, दशमः the tenth, पुत्रः son, अनृतम् a false, वाक्यम् word, न स्मरामि I do not recall, इमौ तु and these two, तव your, पुत्रकौ are the dear sons
entries.96.20: मया by me, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, तपश्चर्या the practice of austerity, कृता has been done, यदि if, इयम् this, मैथिली Maithili, दुष्टा is impure, तस्याः of it, फलम् the fruit, न उपाश्नीयाम् may I not enjoy
entries.96.21: मनसा in thought, कर्मणा in deed, वाचा in word, भूतपूर्वम् ever before, किल्बिषम् न there has been no sin, यदि if, मैथिली Maithili, अपापा is sinless, तस्याः of it, फलम् the fruit, उपाश्नीयाम् may I enjoy
entries.96.22: राघव O Raghava, अहम् I, मनष्षष्ठेषु with mind as the sixth, पञ्चसु in the five, भूतेषु elements, विचिन्त्य having pondered, सीताम् Sita, शुद्धा इति to be pure, वननिर्झरे in the mountain stream of the wood, जग्राह took her in
entries.96.23: इयम् she, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, अपापा sinless, पतिदेवता whose deity is her lord, लोकापवादभीतस्य of you who fear the slander of the world, तव to you, प्रत्ययम् the proof, दास्यति shall give
entries.96.24: नरवरात्मज O son of the best of men, तस्मात् therefore, शुद्धभावा of pure heart, इयम् she, तदा then, दिव्येन by heavenly, दृष्टिविषयेण range of sight, प्रविष्टा was entered into, या who, लोकापवादकलुषीकृतचेतसा by you whose mind was sullied by the slander of the world, त्वया by you, प्रियतमा most beloved, शुद्धा pure, विदिता अपि though known to be, त्यक्ता was abandoned
